title: Error Handling Middleware
prompt:
Create an Express app with a centralized error handling middleware.

**Requirements:**
1. Import `express` and create an app instance
2. Add a GET route at `/api/error` that throws a new Error
3. Define an `errorHandler` function with four parameters `(err, req, res, next)` that sends a JSON error response
4. Register the error handler with `app.use()`
5. Export the app as the default export
hints: Error handling middleware MUST have exactly 4 parameters: (err, req, res, next)
Express identifies error handlers by the 4-parameter signature
Register error handlers after all routes with app.use(errorHandler)
Send error details with res.status(500).json({ error: err.message })

app.js.name: errorHandler
app.js.description: Define error handling middleware with 4 parameters
